t: 法蒂米德埃及将阿斯卡隆的要塞投降给一支由耶路撒冷国王鲍德温三世所率领的十字军、圣殿军和医院兵组…
te: The fortress of Ascalon is surrendered by Fatimid Egypt to an army of crusaders, Templars, and Hospitallers led by King…
dz: 十字军-法蒂米德战争:法蒂米德埃及将阿斯卡隆的要塞投降给一支由耶路撒冷国王鲍德温三世所率领的十字军、圣殿军和医院兵组成的军队.
de: Crusader–Fatimid wars: The fortress of Ascalon is surrendered by Fatimid Egypt to an army of crusaders, Templars, and Hospitallers led by King Baldwin III of Jerusalem.

t: 苏格兰和英格兰之间的标准战.
te: Battle of the Standard between Scotland and England.
dz: 苏格兰和英格兰之间的标准战.
de: Battle of the Standard between Scotland and England.

t: 埃里斯波在布勒顿城镇延克兰附近击败了鲍德人查尔斯,阻止了西弗朗西亚的扩张.
te: Erispoe defeats Charles the Bald near the Breton town of Jengland, halting the expansion of West Francia.
dz: 延格兰战役:埃里斯波在布勒顿城镇延克兰附近击败了鲍德人查尔斯,阻止了西弗朗西亚的扩张.
de: Battle of Jengland: Erispoe defeats Charles the Bald near the Breton town of Jengland, halting the expansion of West Francia.

t: 阿尔博加斯特让欧根纽斯选出了西罗马皇帝.
te: Arbogast has Eugenius elected Western Roman Emperor.
dz: 阿尔博加斯特让欧根纽斯选出了西罗马皇帝.
de: Arbogast has Eugenius elected Western Roman Emperor.
